problem.title: LF-GICP KITTI Odom seq 07 full (1101 frames): sensor-centred Fisher direction
problem.question: Does taking the Fisher-weighting direction in a sensor-centred tangent, instead of the world-origin twist of the paper's Eq. (2), change full-sequence accuracy with one fixed setting?

variants.label: Paper default (fresh reference)
variants.intent: Paper Table SI constants with the localizability-field gate and soft Fisher weighting; rerun on the same binary as the candidate.
variants.note: Voxel-normal localizability field gate + soft Fisher weighting on GICP scan-to-map (no GT seed; anchor matches first GT pose). mitigation=on beta=2 field_beta=0.25 degenerate_frames=13/1101 median_f0=0.200196 median_lambda0=0.020498
variants.readability_note: Uses the default CLI surface only.
variants.extensibility_note: No extra profile knobs beyond the stable core contract.
variants.decision_reason: Best combined benchmark score on the shared dataset and interface.

variants.label: Sensor-centred Fisher direction (not in the paper)
variants.intent: Same gate and weights, with the weakest Hessian eigenvector taken in a tangent centred on the sensor instead of the world origin. Opt-in, default off.
variants.note: Voxel-normal localizability field gate + soft Fisher weighting on GICP scan-to-map (no GT seed; anchor matches first GT pose). mitigation=on beta=2 field_beta=0.25 sensor_centered_fisher=on degenerate_frames=13/1101 median_f0=0.199709 median_lambda0=0.0203827
variants.readability_note: Adds only boolean toggles on top of the stable CLI.
variants.extensibility_note: Still stays inside the stable CLI, but expands the toggle surface.
variants.decision_reason: Useful for comparison, but not strong enough to replace the current default.

variants.label: Vanilla VGICP backend
variants.intent: Same backend with degeneracy handling disabled (paper's vanilla VGICP ablation).
variants.note: Voxel-normal localizability field gate + soft Fisher weighting on GICP scan-to-map (no GT seed; anchor matches first GT pose). mitigation=off beta=2 field_beta=0.25 degenerate_frames=0/1101 median_f0=0.199853 median_lambda0=0.0203901
variants.readability_note: Adds only boolean toggles on top of the stable CLI.
variants.extensibility_note: Still stays inside the stable CLI, but expands the toggle surface.
variants.decision_reason: Useful for comparison, but not strong enough to replace the current default.
